sessionsPerm.kind.command: Matches this exact command — not every Bash call.
sessionsPerm.kind.ssh: Applies to every call of this tool on the same host, for this session.
sessionsPerm.kind.infra: Applies to every command in this group on the same account, for this session.
sessionsPerm.noRule: No rule can match this exact call (compound command, background shell…) — it can only be allowed once.
sessionsPerm.hint.session: This session only, forgotten when it ends.
sessionsPerm.hint.project: Stored in AWOG home, keyed to this project — applies to every session in it, on this machine only. Never committed to the repo.
sessionsPerm.hint.user: Stored in AWOG home — applies to every project on this machine.
sessionsPerm.hint.gate.ssh: This session only, never written to disk. The default SSH approval mode stays on the SSH approval chip.
sessionsPerm.hint.gate.infra: This session only, never written to disk. The permission matrix in Settings → Infrastructure is unchanged.
sessionsPerm.saved.gate: Allowed for the rest of this session:
sessionsPerm.saved.user: Saved for every project on this machine:
sessionsPerm.savedDowngraded: The session belongs to no project, so the rule was only remembered for this session.
sessionsPerm.saveFailed: The rule could not be saved — the next call will ask again.
